scientific_integrity: The proof separates prior alternating-block theory from the newly counted minima and degree polynomial; checked computations are reproducible from the two included scripts.
scientific_limitations: The canonical alternating monochromatic-block encoding and basic flippability condition were already established in arXiv:1412.3685.
Claims of originality are restricted to the closed all-parameter enumeration of simple flip-graph vertices and the explicit full degree polynomial of K_{2,n}.
Equivalent enumerations in unindexed specialized literature remain possible; no independent scholarly audit was performed.
Checker scripts validate finite examples only; infinite-family claims rely on the supplied combinatorial proof.
title: Simplicial orientations and the full flip-degree enumerator of complete bipartite graphs
